name: Daydream Mosaics 6: Empire - Collector's Edition
description:
About This Game

Love and legacy blossom in Daydream Mosaics 6 – Empire! As Raven and Juliette prepare for their long-awaited wedding, they set out to build six magical cities—a vibrant new empire to unite their peoples and celebrate their future together.

Meanwhile, their dear friends Lucas and Reya embark on a heartfelt quest to find the perfect wedding gift, one worthy of the love and dreams shared by Raven and Juliette.

Featuring 204 beautifully crafted nonogram mosaic puzzles, this Collector’s Edition continues the beloved Daydream Mosaics story with even more depth, beauty, and variety. Between mosaic levels, enjoy a diverse selection of relaxing minigames, including:

- Jigsaw Puzzles

- Clutter Challenges

- Hidden Object Scenes

- Spot the Differences

- Match 3 Minigame

With rich visuals, a charming storyline, and hours of engaging puzzles, Daydream Mosaics 6 – Empire is a celebration of creativity, connection, and the magic of building something meaningful together.

Celebrate love. Build an empire. Let the daydream continue!
short_desc: Raven and Juliette are getting married—and while they build six magical cities to unite their peoples, Lucas and Reya set out to find the perfect wedding gift. Enjoy 204 colorful nonogram levels plus jigsaw, clutter, hidden object, match 3, and more in this charming Collector’s Edition!
